bio.text: Jane Bloomingdale is a Republican state representative for Iowa House District 60 and has served in the Iowa House since 2017.
The Iowa Legislature's 2023 biography lists Bloomingdale as owner of Bloomingdale Tax and Accounting, with a B.A.S. from Southern Methodist University, living in Northwood.
It says Bloomingdale served on the Northwood City Council and as mayor of Northwood.
